title: v0.09.2 evaluator emitted stale v0.09 metric namespace
observation: evaluate_v0092_corpus returned v009_spec_quality_acceptance_rate even though the frozen v0.09.2 evaluation plan names the guardrail v0092_spec_quality_acceptance_rate.
root_cause: The retry evaluator was adapted from the historical v0.09 evaluator and one version-qualified metric key was not renamed.
disposition: Correct the non-frozen v0.09.2 evaluator key only; preserve the historical v0.09 evaluator and every v0.09.2 frozen artifact unchanged. Add REG-0023 to require current evaluator metric names to be a subset of the frozen plan namespace.
